title: Explosive Dinosaurs
description:
+40 FUN COMPETITIVE MINIGAMES FEATURING DINOS AND EXPLOSIONS!

Want to challenge your friends and have a blast? The goal is simple: Compete and have fun!
Up to 4 players with just one game. Play it online with Steam Remote Play!

Features:
• +40 unique multiplayer minigames to enjoy with friends.

• Up to 4 players using XBOX controllers or Xinput compatible gamepads.

• Steam Remote Play

• No random winners, all minigames require skill!

• PREHISTORY MODE: Play solo or with a buddy to unlock new minigames.

• TEAM MODE (2v2): One teammate wins the minigame while the other sabotages the other team.

• CRAZY ARCADE CHALLENGE: Endless minigames, only one try—good luck!

• CHILD MODE: An easy solo difficulty mode for training newcomers!

TL;DR: Pizza, 4 controllers, 3 pals, and blew the competition away!
description_short: These dinos really know how to detonate a party!
